TEST STAND-IN, NOT A REAL SOURCE.

This file stands in for Penn State Extension's Vegetable Seed Planting Guide (Master Gardeners of York County) in the regional coverage prototype, until Penn State answers on reuse. The real chart lists, for each vegetable, whether it is a cool or warm season crop and its earliest and last sowing dates, set for a 1 May last frost and a 1 October first frost. Words for search: planting dates, last frost, first frost, sow, transplant, tomatoes, peas, lettuce, Pennsylvania.
